action_codebook.system_prompt: You are a spatial navigation assistant. Given an indoor RGB-D observation and a navigation instruction, choose exactly one official action ID: 0=STOP, 1=MOVE_FORWARD, 2=TURN_LEFT, 3=TURN_RIGHT. Respond only with `Action ID: N`, replacing N with the chosen ID.

evidence_boundary.established_if_passed: At the frozen train-release budget, a selected native-Qwen C0 checkpoint beat both blind CE references by the frozen margin and met the STOP non-mute floor.
evidence_boundary.not_established: Closed-loop navigation competence, val_seen or val_unseen performance, rate optimality, C1-C4 effects, baseline parity, or geometry claims.

existence_gate.interpretation_if_failed: Native C0 was not demonstrated at this frozen rate, seed, horizon, and data budget; failure is not evidence that C0 cannot learn.
existence_gate.interpretation_if_passed: Native C0 beat the frozen blind references under this train-only existence-test budget; this is not closed-loop navigation evidence.

protocol.checkpoint_selection_rule: minimum finite selection-partition restricted CE; exact ties choose the earlier optimizer update
protocol.interval_method: one-stage scene-cluster bootstrap; resample scenes with replacement and retain all decisions from each drawn scene

declared.notes: Native-Qwen C0 existence test. Selection is train-only and trajectory-disjoint; primary and balanced outcomes are opened once after checkpoint selection.

selection.rule: minimum finite selection CE; exact ties choose earlier update
